name: startup
js: (async()=>{window.__pitchMapWait=(condition,label,timeout=120000)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const begin=performance.now();const poll=()=>{try{if(condition())return resolve(true);if(performance.now()-begin>timeout)return reject(Error('Timed out: '+label));setTimeout(poll,100);}catch(error){reject(error);}};poll();});await window.__pitchMapWait(()=>window.__moondaTest&&window.__moonda?.progress?.done,'startup progress.done',150000);window.__moondaTest.setLanguage('en');const enter=document.querySelector('.start-enter');if(enter&&!enter.disabled)enter.click();document.querySelector('.moonda-tutorial-visible .moonda-tutorial-close')?.click();await window.__pitchMapWait(()=>!document.querySelector('.start-enter'),'start screen dismissal',10000);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));await window.__pitchMapWait(()=>{document.querySelector('.moonda-tutorial-visible .moonda-tutorial-close')?.click();return !document.querySelector('.moonda-tutorial-visible');},'tutorial dismissal',10000);return {done:window.__moonda.progress.done};})()

name: abSetup
js: (()=>{const L=window.__moonda.lander;window.__farABSnapshot=()=>{const C=window.__moondaCesium,v=window.__viewer,L=window.__moonda.lander,g=v.scene.globe,tiles=g._surface._tilesToRender,foot=g.ellipsoid.cartesianToCartographic(L.driver.feet);let tri=0,under=0,source=0;const levels={};for(const t of tiles){const m=t.data?.renderedMesh;if(m){tri+=(m.indexCountWithoutSkirts??m.indices?.length??0)/3;levels[t.level]=(levels[t.level]??0)+1;}if(C.Rectangle.contains(t.rectangle,foot)){under=Math.max(under,t.level);for(let p=t;p;p=p.parent){if(p.data?.terrainData&&!p.data.terrainData.wasCreatedByUpsampling?.()){source=Math.max(source,p.level);break;}}}}return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,dpr:devicePixelRatio},tiles:tiles.length,triangles:tri,levels,underRoverDrawLevel:under,underRoverSourceLevel:source,resScale:v.resolutionScale,lod:L.lod?.level,gpuMs:L.lod?.gpu,fog:{density:v.scene.fog.density,sse:v.scene.fog.screenSpaceErrorFactor},speed:L.driver.speed,heading:L.driver.heading,phase:L.phase};};return window.__farABSnapshot();})()
